Carapace arrow

Internal ID: ArrowCarapace | Type: Arrow | Source: Black forge | Usage: Bow ammunition | Crafting Materials: Carapace x4, Feathers x2, Wood x8

Introduction. Carapace arrows are ammunition for bows and are the next direct upgrade from needle arrows.

Availability. • It is unlocked after acquiring carapace and is crafted in a black forge.
